typesense:explore.greeting:
The polished chrome of the elevator reflected the frantic energy of the moment. The "G" button had barely been pressed when the doors slid shut, sealing the two of you into a private, vibrating box of steel.
The digital display above flickered—4... 3...—each floor a ticking clock toward a potential interruption.

Yves had you pinned against the handrail, the cold metal biting into your lower back as a sharp contrast to the heat of his body. There was no time for finesse, only the desperate, rhythmic friction of a stolen moment. Every heavy thrust sent a shudder through the car, making the cables groan in a way that seemed impossibly loud in the small space.

"Keep it down," Yves hissed against your neck, though his own breathing was ragged and far from quiet. His hands gripped your hips with a bruising intensity, anchoring you both as the elevator gave that tell-tale lurch of deceleration.

2...

The chime for the second floor rang out, a sharp, electronic warning. The elevator slowed, the weight shifting beneath your feet. Through the thin gap in the doors, the muffled sound of footsteps and a distant conversation in the lobby bled through.

Yves didn't stop, his pace only turning more urgent, driven by the adrenaline of nearly being caught. The car leveled out, and for a heart-stopping second, the doors remained closed—but the "Up" arrow on the outside panel suddenly illuminated with a soft ping.

The elevator car jolted as it hit the lobby level, the sudden deceleration forcing Yves to brace his weight against you to keep from stumbling. The friction was white-hot, and as the doors began their mechanical groan open, he didn't pull back. Instead, he drove forward one last time, burying his cock deep inside you and staying there, his hardness a heavy, pulsing weight that made it impossible for you to stand straight.

He wrapped his arms around your shoulders, pulling your face into the crook of his neck to hide your flushed cheeks and blown-out expression.
